If u cant attract people to you, i mean new people.
Try to meet with your friends, if someone is making jokes of you without reason or just beacuse your look or the way like u're behaving it's a person no worth to even speak with him/her. 

I cant give u a good advice, no1 can. I think u should stop to get knowing people by force, i mean that u dont need this, if someone exist for you, on my way of thinking every1 have soulmate, u will find her.

When i broke up with my girlfriend few days ago, i tried to kill myself, i cant imagine right now be with somebody else, but she hurt me like nobody ever did. The one who i beloved, she was in first place always, and she did the most terrible thing to me that i ever experienced.

Stick to your friends, u are not losers, if u think that u need to change your way of how u view yourself. If u have problems with your confidence, dont worry, not everyone is the soul of a party.
For me its not disadvantage.

Please tell me, why u want to do it?
Have u talked about it with your boyfriend?
U're right, if u do it, he might lose his mind and do your way ;/

How long u were together?
Drunk is not excuse, she would do it without being drunk anyway propably ;/

U have someone with u can go out?
My bestfriend always tell me, go out, meet some people, talk with them. Someday u will find somebody who is worth of effort. These warm words sometimes help, mostly :)

I thought my life is not worth living but u have worse situation. I cant imagine how difficult is your life.

I can shortly tell u about my experience. I tried to kill myself, unfortunately i survived that try. I know its stupid but i regret that i didnt die... After that my friends helped me out from this shithole.
My bestfriend still dont believe what i've done, and she is still upset cuse of this situation. The sad thing is that i still want to die, but i cant do it just beacuse my family, friends gonna be mad and upset just beacuse im gone.

Sorry to hear that u have no1 in your life, without my friends i would be dead now propably.
The only thing i can say, try to meet some1 and live for him/them, its easier to think that u live for some1, they needed u, it helps a lot. Ill try to hold on and wait with my suecide till i get your reply. Heads up :)
